“Applicable Laws” means all supranational, national, state and local laws, rules and regulations and guidelines governing the activities of a Party described in this Agreement within the Territory that are applicable to the manufacture, use, storage, import, export and handling of the Miltenyi Products, including any applicable rules, regulations, guidelines, and other requirements of any Regulatory Authority that may be in effect in the Territory from time to time.

obligations.action: Sell Miltenyi Products to Bellicum
obligations.summary: Miltenyi must sell Miltenyi Products to Bellicum in accordance with the Agreement.
obligations.text: Miltenyi desires to sell to Bellicum, and Bellicum desires to purchase from Miltenyi, the Miltenyi Products in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.

obligations.action: Purchase Miltenyi Products from Miltenyi
obligations.summary: Bellicum must purchase Miltenyi Products from Miltenyi in accordance with the Agreement.
obligations.text: Miltenyi desires to sell to Bellicum, and Bellicum desires to purchase from Miltenyi, the Miltenyi Products in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.

obligations.action: Supply and sell Miltenyi Products
obligations.summary: Miltenyi must supply and sell Miltenyi Products to Bellicum or its Licensees or Subcontractors during the Term.
obligations.text: Miltenyi will non-exclusively supply and sell to Bellicum or its Licensees or Subcontractors, and Bellicum or its Licensees or Subcontractors will purchase from Miltenyi, Miltenyi Products listed on Exhibit B solely for the Permitted Use (as defined below).

obligations.action: Purchase Miltenyi Products
obligations.summary: Bellicum or its Licensees or Subcontractors must purchase Miltenyi Products from Miltenyi solely for the Permitted Use.
obligations.text: Bellicum or its Licensees or Subcontractors will purchase from Miltenyi, Miltenyi Products listed on Exhibit B solely for the Permitted Use (as defined below).

obligations.action: Notify Miltenyi of additional Bellicum Product
obligations.summary: Bellicum must promptly notify Miltenyi in writing of any additional Bellicum Product manufactured using Miltenyi Products.
obligations.text: Bellicum shall promptly notify Miltenyi in writing of any additional Bellicum Product from time to time manufactured by or on behalf of Bellicum (or any of its Licensees, if any) by using one or more Miltenyi Products, which Bellicum Product shall be added to Exhibit A by amendment; subsequently, the Parties shall agree upon the Bellicum Product specific Module within sixty (60) days.

obligations.action: Instruct and oblige Licensees and Subcontractors
obligations.summary: Bellicum must instruct and oblige its Licensees and Subcontractors to comply with the Agreement and Applicable Laws.
obligations.text: Bellicum shall instruct and oblige its Licensees and Subcontractors accordingly.

obligations.action: Supervise use of Miltenyi Products
obligations.summary: Bellicum must ensure use of Miltenyi Products is supervised by a technically qualified individual.
obligations.text: Use of the Miltenyi Products by Bellicum, its Licensees or Subcontractors shall be supervised by a technically qualified individual.

obligations.action: Evaluate regulatory requirements for Additional Country
obligations.summary: Upon Bellicum's written request, the Parties must evaluate regulatory requirements for using Miltenyi Products in an Additional Country.
obligations.text: The Parties agree, upon reasonable written request by Bellicum from time to time during the term of this Agreement, to evaluate the regulatory requirements for utilizing of Miltenyi Products for manufacture of Bellicum Products in the requested Additional Country(ies).

obligations.action: Negotiate agreement for Additional Work
obligations.summary: The Parties must negotiate in good faith to agree on terms for Miltenyi's provision of Additional Work for Additional Country.
obligations.text: the Parties will negotiate in good faith with the goal of entering into an agreement on mutually acceptable terms with respect to Miltenyi’s provision of such Additional Work.

obligations.action: Bellicum to inform Miltenyi of intended regulatory filing
obligations.summary: Bellicum must inform Miltenyi in writing at least 12 months before any intended regulatory filing in an Additional Country.
obligations.text: Bellicum shall inform Miltenyi in writing at least twelve (12) months in advance prior to any intended regulatory filing in an Additional Country.
obligations.deadline: at least twelve (12) months in advance prior to any intended regulatory filing

obligations.action: Miltenyi to consider Bellicum's concerns about subcontractors
obligations.summary: Miltenyi must reasonably take into account Bellicum’s written concerns regarding proposed Affiliates or Subcontractors.
obligations.text: provided that (i) Miltenyi shall reasonably take into account Bellicum’s written concerns regarding proposed Affiliate(s) or Subcontractor(s);

obligations.action: Miltenyi responsible for subcontracted activities
obligations.summary: Miltenyi is fully responsible for performance of all delegated and subcontracted activities by its Affiliates and Subcontractors.
obligations.text: Miltenyi shall be solely and fully responsible for the performance of all delegated and subcontracted activities by its Affiliates and Subcontractor(s), including compliance with the terms of this Agreement and the Quality Agreement (as applicable), and in no event shall any such delegation or subcontract release Miltenyi from any of its obligations under this Agreement.

obligations.action: Miltenyi to ensure compliance with Applicable Laws
obligations.summary: Miltenyi must ensure that its, its Affiliates', and Subcontractors' activities in manufacturing and supplying Miltenyi Products comply with Applicable Laws.
obligations.text: Miltenyi shall have sole responsibility for ensuring, and shall ensure, that Miltenyi’s and its Affiliates’ and Subcontractors’ activities and performance in connection with the manufacture of Miltenyi Products and the supply of such Miltenyi Products to Bellicum under this Agreement are at all times in compliance with Applicable Laws.

obligations.action: Miltenyi to obtain and maintain licenses for manufacturing
obligations.summary: Miltenyi must obtain and maintain all licenses, permits, authorizations, or registrations required by Applicable Laws for manufacturing and delivery of Miltenyi Products.
obligations.text: it shall be the sole responsibility of Miltenyi to obtain and maintain, and Miltenyi shall obtain and maintain, all licenses, permits, authorizations, or registrations required by Applicable Laws in order for Miltenyi, its Affiliates, and/or Subcontractors (as the case may be) to manufacture and make Delivery of Miltenyi Products, except as otherwise provided in this Agreement, at Miltenyi’s expense.

obligations.action: Bellicum to ensure compliance with Applicable Laws for use
obligations.summary: Bellicum must ensure that use of Miltenyi Products for Permitted Use by itself, its Subcontractors and Licensees is in compliance with Applicable Laws.
obligations.text: Bellicum shall have sole responsibility for ensuring, and shall ensure, that the use of the Miltenyi Products for their respective Permitted Use by Bellicum, its Subcontractors and Licensees (as the case may be) is at all times in compliance with Applicable Laws.

obligations.action: Bellicum to obtain and maintain licenses for use
obligations.summary: Bellicum must obtain and maintain all licenses, permits, authorizations, registrations, additional validations or additional testing required by Applicable Laws for use of Miltenyi Products for Permitted Use.
obligations.text: it shall be the sole responsibility of Bellicum to obtain and maintain, and Bellicum shall obtain and maintain, all licenses, permits, authorizations, registrations, additional validations or additional testing required by Applicable Laws in order for Bellicum, its Subcontractors and Licensees to use the Miltenyi Products for the Permitted Use, at Bellicum’s expense.

obligations.action: Miltenyi to assist Bellicum in obtaining licenses
obligations.summary: Miltenyi must comply with reasonable requests for assistance by Bellicum in obtaining licenses, permits, authorizations, registrations, additional validations or additional testing, with scope and costs agreed by the Parties.
obligations.text: Miltenyi shall comply with all reasonable requests for assistance by Bellicum in connection with Bellicum’s efforts to obtain such licenses, permits, authorizations, registrations, additional validations or additional testing, to the extent applicable to the Miltenyi Products; provided that the Parties shall agree on the scope of such assistance to be provided by Miltenyi and upon the reasonable costs to be paid by Bellicum to Miltenyi for such assistance.

obligations.action: Bellicum to notify Miltenyi of safety/quality issues
obligations.summary: Bellicum must promptly notify Miltenyi in writing if it receives notice from a Regulatory Authority raising safety or quality issues concerning any Miltenyi Product.
obligations.text: Bellicum shall promptly notify Miltenyi of the same in writing.
obligations.deadline: promptly

obligations.action: Miltenyi to cure safety/quality issues
obligations.summary: Upon notification, Miltenyi must make efforts to cure safety or quality issues relating to Miltenyi Products as promptly as possible, at its expense unless issues solely relate to Bellicum’s Permitted Use.
obligations.text: Miltenyi shall make [...***...] to cure such safety or quality issue(s) as they relate to the Miltenyi Products as promptly as possible, and unless such issues solely relate to Bellicum’s Permitted Use of the relevant Miltenyi Product(s) in connection with the manufacture or use of a Bellicum Product, such efforts shall be at Miltenyi’s sole expense.
obligations.deadline: as promptly as possible

obligations.action: Maintain accurate financial records
obligations.summary: Each Party must ensure its financial books, accounts, records and invoices related to this Agreement are complete and accurate in all material respects.
obligations.text: its financial books, accounts, records and invoices related to this Agreement or related to any work conducted for or on behalf of the other Party are and will be complete and accurate in all material respects.

obligations.action: Bind Subcontractors/Licensees to consistent obligations
obligations.summary: Bellicum must ensure its Subcontractors/Licensees are bound in writing by obligations consistent with those imposed on Bellicum.

obligations.action: Remain responsible for payment and use by designees

obligations.action: Impose consistent obligations on Subcontractors/Licensees and notify Miltenyi
